mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an active monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs fall.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 550,000 units per month signal a contraction in residential demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending weakens.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and high unemployment (UNRATE > 9.0%) signal a severe recession with accommodative policy, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recovery expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 9.0, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), a payroll employment level above 130,000 thousand signals labor market stabilization, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.5% and PAYEMS > 130000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS > 130,000 thousand) indicates labor market strength, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring supports earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 130000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as output declines weaken corporate margins.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts below 550,000 units (HOUST < 550.0) and industrial production below 95 (INDPRO < 95.0) signal broad economic weakness across demand and supply sectors, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 550.0 and INDPRO < 95.0, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During post-recession recovery (as indicated by rising consumer spending), real personal consumption above 340,000 million dollars (RSAFS > 340000.0) signals sustained economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when regime is post-recession recovery and RSAFS > 340000.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
